artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan landing R2 (Rigidity.lean), R1 (SameLogic.lean) and the sharpness witnesses (RigiditySharpness.lean) from the research report's compiled scratch, with aggregator, README, inventory, root, theorem-ledger and C14-pin plumbing, and a full acceptance gate; challenge block pins 9 identifiers.

memory_candidates.content: Adding a new library module to BimodalLogic's FormalSystem tree has a fixed plumbing checklist beyond the .lean file itself, and every item is gated: (1) an import line + `## Modules` bullet in the directory aggregator; (2) a table row + `## Key Results` bullet in the directory README (naming headlines there also clears C17's dead-declaration scan); (3) parent READMEs: some carry hand-maintained file lists with counts (e.g. `Semantics/README.md`'s Correspondence row), others carry `BEGIN GENERATED` inventory blocks re-emitted by `scripts/check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory` (never hand-edited); (4) `lake exe mk_all --lib FormalSystem` regenerates the root, `--check` gates it (C33 byte-compares); (5) any `docs/theorem-index.md` row needs the declaration's docstring to carry a `Paper:` line (anchor or `—` + reason, C15 round trip) AND a `#print axioms` line in the C14 baseline heredoc, because the ledger's Axioms column is generated from baselines, never typed. Plan these as one phase after the modules land, not as afterthoughts.
